forms.name: help
forms.description: Explain available commands without contacting optional services.

forms.name: info
forms.description: Identify the local management program and its capabilities, not the human administrator or application health.

forms.name: status
forms.description: Observe managed resources with separate intent, activity, health, reachability and power meanings; retain timestamp and provenance.

forms.name: list
forms.description: Enumerate authorized retained operations with exact optional resource filtering and complete bounded continuation. Active selection preserves unresolved effects and holds even for terminal operations; retained history gaps are explicit. Discover non-effectful prepared capsules through workflow.list.

forms.name: show
forms.description: Inspect the outcome of the exact original request; absence of a reply does not prove absence of work.

forms.name: apply
forms.description: Submit the exact reviewed plan and digest using the current owner authority generation and original request identity; acknowledgement means accepted responsibility, not completed execution.

forms.name: plan-stdin
forms.description: Read the complete exact Subject from stdin and independently resolve this local owner identity. Stage the canonical PrepareRequest under plan-input custody and submit one bounded plan.prepare reference. Preserve the complete selection across upload interruption; no items are truncated or divided into separate Plans to fit a frame. The owner binds current principal, resource, owner epoch and byte identity before preparing the reviewable Plan.

forms.name: app-check
forms.description: Observe the selected application; checking does not silently repair it or adopt new source.

forms.name: app-restart
forms.description: Plan a restart of the selected application under its already accepted release.

forms.name: app-repair
forms.description: Plan restoration of accepted application configuration without silently upgrading or replacing data.

forms.name: app-backup
forms.description: Plan a recovery capture; capture success and restore-drill evidence remain distinct.

forms.name: cancel
forms.description: Request cancellation of the exact operation. Confirmed effects remain and unknown effects must be reconciled; cancellation does not promise rollback or release holds.

forms.name: show-epoch
forms.description: Resolve the original request against the exact owner authority generation.

forms.name: workflow-show
forms.description: Inspect the exact retained owner capsule, including preparation before child operations exist.

forms.name: workflow-prepare
forms.description: Read a complete workflow PrepareRequest from stdin, stage its canonical bytes as workflow-input through content.begin/chunk/commit, and submit the bounded InputReference. Retain its typed immutable proposal and locally owned content before acknowledging the non-effectful capsule. Preparation is not acceptance of child effects; stdin or frame bounds cannot silently cut its complete closure.

forms.name: workflow-advance
forms.description: Read a complete AdvanceRequest from stdin and submit it through staged workflow-input custody using the bounded InputReference. New advances compare the exact local generation and driver term. Transfer completion requires every participant's verified transferred witness and atomically retains the completion evidence, procedure phase and immutable advance receipt. Exact accepted advance IDs replay before new-admission expiry or generation checks.

forms.name: workflow-transfer
forms.description: Read a complete WorkflowTransferRequest from stdin and submit it through staged workflow-input custody using the bounded InputReference. Preserve every participant and prerequisite witness, regardless of frame size. New phases compare the current local generation; an identical accepted phase replays its discoverable original generation, proposal and witnesses. The new driver completes the transfer through workflow.advance with the complete commit closure. Timeout never releases custody.

forms.name: record-read
forms.description: Read one bounded chunk using the exact RecordReference, offset and length from closed stdin input. Reauthorize the actual receiving principal and protected snapshot scope; no reference is bearer authority.

forms.name: logs
forms.description: Read a bounded log page using exact owner epoch, resource, nullable opaque cursor and limit from closed stdin input. Every page, including an empty page, retains owner/resource identity and explicit continuation.

forms.name: owner-history
forms.description: Enumerate all authorized retained origin epochs through the independently authenticated current owner. The owner filters before disclosure. Opaque continuation pins current custodian, actual receiving principal, original filters and traversal snapshot. Revoked permission or a changed custodian invalidates continuation; a fresh client needs no previous epoch or client cache. Read the exact closed request from stdin.

forms.name: history-list
forms.description: Enumerate original immutable record references under one verified custody descriptor, using current principal permission. Native filtering retains terminal work with unresolved effects or holds, and non-effectful prepared workflow capsules. active_only is false for Plans. A page is not a total collection cap; permission, exact filters and custody remain pinned across continuation. References disclose no execution authority. Read the exact closed request from stdin.

forms.name: history-read
forms.description: Read exact original snapshot bytes after current-owner authorization of its protected resource and verified custody membership. The reference retains the original owner epoch and exact installed historical schema closure. It cannot register a reader or authorize new work. Read the exact closed request from stdin.

forms.name: history-content
forms.description: Read original retained input or result bytes after current-owner authorization of the handle's protected resource and its membership in the verified restoration closure. A known handle or former principal permission is insufficient. Original handle identity and digest remain unchanged; complete bytes must be verified before use. Read the exact closed request from stdin.

forms.name: workflow-bind
forms.description: Read a complete reviewed BindRequest from stdin, stage its canonical workflow-input bytes and submit the bounded InputReference. Bind a declared continuation to actual verified predecessor outputs and current participant generation, retain exact content and immutable replay receipt, and preserve installed phase ordering. Binding does not accept child effects.

forms.name: plan-get
forms.description: Read the exact closed owner/plan_digest lookup from stdin. All fields are discoverable from the accepted Operation. Current read authorization and retained immutable Plan identity apply even after its admission deadline; client state is not required.

forms.name: workflow-recover
forms.description: Read a complete closed workflow recovery phase input, stage its canonical workflow-input bytes and submit the bounded reference. Preparation durably reserves one exact successor and retires the original child-admission set; commit requires the independently authenticated complete participant preparation closure. Retire-unprepared obtains a finite current-owner proof for an original participant that never prepared, only after positive authoritative no-preparation/no-child checks, native fencing, permanent old-admission tombstones and retained input/hold custody. It does not invent an original capsule or select a successor. Abandonment irreversibly closes an unused successor at every current participant, including peers that never prepared it, before a different successor may be reviewed. An accepted successor child forbids abandonment. Current scoped recovery authority, settled original effects and retained holds remain required. Old work and abandoned child requests never regain execution authority.

authorization: actual receiving principal, same protected owner use cases
